class.name: SiONVoice
class.brief_description: Container for the configuration of a synthesized voice.
class.description: A new voice can be created using the factory method [method create]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var voice := SiONVoice.create() voice.name = "My Instrument" [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] Using the class constructor creates a voice with every parameter set to default, which is not desirable most of the time. A large number of preconfigured voices can be accessed via [SiONVoicePresetUtil].

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a new instance of [SiONVoice]. Prefer using this method instead of the class constructor.

method.name: create_engine
method.description: Creates native engine structure without looking up a preset. Registered scalar parameters start with their schema's reset values and use [method set_engine_param]. Use [constant SiONDriver.CHIP_AUTO] for engines identified only by their module. Analog-like voices start with two operators; other modules start with one.

method.name: get_engine_param_descriptors
method.description: Returns the registered scalar contract for an engine module. Each descriptor contains engine_kind_id, param_id (stable numeric identity), id (stable string identity), scalar_type (the value's [enum Variant.Type]: [constant TYPE_INT], [constant TYPE_FLOAT] or [constant TYPE_BOOL]), min_value, max_value, reset_value, instance_count and realtime. A parameter holds instance_count independent values selected by index; the engine owns what an index denotes, such as an operator. This is a preparation-thread API. An unregistered engine returns an empty descriptor list.

method.name: set_engine_param
method.description: Writes preparation state using the identity from [method get_engine_param_descriptors]. The value must have the registered scalar_type and lie inside the registered range, and index must select one of the registered instances. Copying or cloning a voice preserves this state independently. Live channels receive edits through SiONDriver.mailbox_set_engine_param with the same identity, value and index, plus track and exact entity/slot scope IDs.

method.name: get_engine_param
method.description: Reads the registered scalar from this voice's preparation state. Uses the same index as [method set_engine_param]; unknown identities or indices outside the registered instances report an error.

method.name: get_mml
method.description: Returns a configuration of this voice as an MML string. This string can be then passed back to the driver for playback, alongside a melody. Use [param index] to specify an internal index for this voice, which can then be referenced elsewhere in your MML string. Use [param chip_type] to force the type used when generating voice configuration. By default voice's actual chip type is used. Use [param append_postfix] to include additional configuration for this voice, such as filter and modulation settings from the channel.

method.name: get_params
method.description: Returns a configuration of this voice as an array of integers. The voice is treated as a SiOPM voice.
